description: Deterministic domain risk and trust evaluation returning ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK. Decision for observed evidence; external evidence may change between calls. Uses DNS, RDAP, TLS, HTTP/redirect, URLhaus threat reputation, local indicators. Read-only: external read queries only, no action on domain, no persistence, limited cache. USE WHEN: decide whether domain is safe enough for interaction, onboarding, outreach, or payment. DO NOT USE WHEN: consolidated domain health/operational inspection (use domain_agent_discovery_check) or email validation (use email_suitability_decision). Example: domain='example.com'.

domain.description: Bare public hostname (e.g., example.com). No protocol, path, query, or fragment. Localhost and IP literals rejected.
domain.title: Domain

name: domain_risk_trust_decision

confidence.description: Confidence in the decision from 0 to 100.

dmarc.description: DMARC records derived from observed DNS TXT records (v=dmarc1).

evidence_complete.description: Whether all evidence sources were available.

risk_level.description: Risk level derived from observed signals.

signals.description: Evidence source states (DNS, RDAP, TLS, HTTP, threat intel).

spf.description: SPF records derived from observed DNS TXT records (v=spf1).
